scenario.title: Six-item transformer inventory buy with Buy American and schedule screening
scenario.summary: The real Port Angeles package contains six transformer bid items, an USD 800,000 estimate, Buy American certification, and IEEE/ANSI requirements, but no public delivery ceiling. Controlled clarification supplies that missing schedule.

realism.notes: The six transformer quantities, USD 800,000 estimate, Buy American requirement, and standards references are frozen public facts. The delivery ceiling, supplier behavior, and quote values are synthetic.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Lower-price offer that does not satisfy Buy American.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: all six bid items are required and delivery must be within 180 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 760,000 for all six transformer items, certified Buy American and standards-compliant, but requires 220 days.
Supplier B quotes USD 780,000 for all six items, Buy American certified and standards-compliant, with 170-day delivery.
Supplier C quotes USD 700,000 with 160-day delivery but cannot provide the required Buy American certification.

hard_constraints.description: The missing delivery ceiling must be clarified before RFQ.
Total awarded price must not exceed the real USD 800,000 government estimate.
Awarded offer must satisfy Buy American certification.
Awarded offer must satisfy referenced IEEE/ANSI transformer requirements and exact public quantities.
All six required transformer items must be covered exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier B is the only offer satisfying budget, schedule, Buy American, standards, and all six quantities.

failure_conditions: Awarding Supplier A despite the late delivery.
Awarding Supplier C without Buy American certification.
Ignoring any required transformer item or quantity.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
